description: A best-effort step: fetch a page, and if the fetch fails (a timeout, a refused host) carry on with a fallback text instead of failing the run. The fetch step sets on_error "continue", so the http.request error result {error: {code, message}} is kept as its output and the run goes to the branch, which tests exists steps.fetch.output.error. The same pattern fits a link-card thumbnail upload (http.request with body_from_url, which answers body_source_rejected for an oversize or non-image file) or one of several news sources being down. The example needs no agent: it uses platform tools only.

spec.name: Best-effort fetch
spec.description: Fetch a page; use its text, or a fallback text when the fetch reported an error.
